2 Dec 2026 · Press release

The shyrdak is on view in Room 5

The 1930s shyrdak felt KW-2026-009 is back in the Palace of Art, in Room 5. A panel beside it shows the felt before and after treatment.

16 Dec 2026 · Press release

Christmas: no assessments on 24 and 31 December

There are no free assessments on Thursday 24 or Thursday 31 December. Assessments resume on 7 January, 10:00 to 13:00.

25 Jan 2027 · Press release

Trainee conservator, metals: applications close on 31 January

The two-year traineeship, with training abroad paid by the Körköm Foundation, is open until 31 January. Write to the Palace of Art, palace@korkom.org.

8 Mar 2027 · Press release

A trainee for the metals bench

The Palace of Art has chosen its trainee conservator for metals from the applications received. The traineeship begins in April.

14 Apr 2027 · Press release

Assessments for parishes after Easter

Parishes that want an icon, a cross or church silver looked at can bring it on any Thursday from 15 April, 10:00 to 13:00. Wrap it in a clean sheet and bring the parish's letter.

2 Jun 2027 · Press release

Last school visit of the year

The last school and student visit before the summer is on Wednesday 2 June, through the Palace of Art. Visits resume in October.

12 Jul 2027 · Press release

Summer: assessments in July only

Free assessments continue on Thursdays in July. The workshop is closed in August; the benches reopen on 1 September.

6 Sep 2027 · Press release

Autumn on the bench

The workshop is open again. Thursday assessments resume on 9 September, 10:00 to 13:00.
